purpose: Test whether the A9 seed-free direct surface-cap detector generalizes across multiple cap heights entirely inside the independently qualified 0-1 cm surface-face envelope. This gate stops at cap-event detection/localization; generalized post-cap runoff continuation is a separate later gate.

candidate_policy.same_A9_seed_rule: For each cap, evaluate q_top0 once at the committed S0/top-head and set tau_seed=(S_cap-S0)/(q_supply-q_top0).
candidate_policy.no_event_rule: If S0+max(q_supply,0)*DeltaT < S_cap, certify no cap event with zero nonlinear solves.

reference_policy.surface_flux: independent high-accuracy exact surface-face reference at the tested cap
reference_policy.dual_start_A: committed soil heads plus the same algebraic tau_seed
reference_policy.dual_start_B: heads halfway from committed values toward zero plus tau_seed*1.05 clipped to the open interval
reference_policy.accept_reference_case_only_if: both reference starts converge to finite physically ordered strict-interior roots, each closes mass below 1e-9 cm, and the two reference roots agree within the frozen reference-pair gates

hard_guards: Caps are frozen before execution and all lie within the already qualified 0-1 cm surface-face range.
Do not add caps above 1 cm or below/equal to the initial 0.02 cm surface storage.
Do not remove a cap/profile combination after execution.
Do not use an A4/A8/A9 event root as candidate seed or lookup.
Do not add full-trajectory event search or multi-start candidate logic after execution.
Do not relax A9 candidate/reference accuracy, mass or face-cost gates.
A10A does not qualify generalized runoff continuation after the cap event.
Do not add other materials, top-node saturation, endpoint response tangents, runtime, MultiSWAP or groundwater.

architecture_checks.4_compact_state: No cap-event time or detector state is persistent.
architecture_checks.5_worker_scratch: Event seeds and nonlinear vectors remain worker-local.
architecture_checks.7_transactionality: Event state is unpublished until accepted; failed/no-event controls leave committed state and runoff ledger untouched.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Event tau is generic within the explicit 0.05 d interval.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation: Every accepted candidate/reference event closes below 1e-9 cm with no repair.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Exactly one candidate event corrector per positive case, zero nonlinear solves for algebraically impossible controls.
architecture_checks.28_runtime_composition: Cap height is an external surface/runtime parameter; no cap logic enters the Ross face kernel.

hard_nonclaims: No automatic detector robustness for inconclusive direct-corrector failures.
No production, runtime or MultiSWAP admission.
